offering_description.value: Labcorp provides routine and specialty diagnostic testing for healthcare providers, patients and employers. It analyzes specimens in its laboratory network and provides central laboratory testing and early development research for pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies.

primary_services.value: routine clinical laboratory testing; specialty and genetic testing; workplace drug testing; central laboratory testing for clinical trials; nonclinical drug development studies

customer_segment.value: B2B: physician practices, hospitals, health systems, employers, and pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies; B2C: patients and consumers who order or pay for lab tests; B2G: government healthcare agencies that procure laboratory testing

end_markets.value: healthcare diagnostics; pharmaceutical and biotechnology research; workplace health and safety; consumer health testing

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: commercial insurers and public health programs reimburse eligible diagnostic tests; project or contract: drug developers pay for clinical trial laboratory work and early development studies; service fees: patients, employers and healthcare organizations pay directly for testing
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: analyzes specimens and conducts studies for healthcare providers, patients, employers and drug developers; asset operator: operates laboratories and specimen collection centers serving patients, healthcare providers and research sponsors

geography_served.value: global: U.S. diagnostics and biopharma laboratory operations across North America, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: clinical diagnostics, central laboratory testing for clinical trials and early drug development research

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: physician practices, health systems, employers and biopharma sponsors; own locations: patient service centers for specimen collection; online: consumer test ordering and provider portals for test orders and results

regulatory_exposure.value: high: clinical laboratory testing requires CLIA certification and applicable state licenses, and regulated nonclinical studies follow FDA good laboratory practice rules
